Smoother play and the last four weapons. Still tested in Azahar only, so console reports are welcome.

**What changed**

- The steel pipe, great knife, chainsaw and Hyper Spray can now be picked up in a normal run. The chainsaw and the Hyper Spray turn up on a New Game after the endings that unlock them, as on the PC.
- The Hyper Spray sprays the PC's mist cloud.
- Models placed in the stages and enemy models now load in the background, so walking through town or into a new room no longer stalls for a moment. In Azahar's sweep of every room, no room drops a frame after its load on either model.

**Updating from 0.1.0**

Install the new `sh23ds.cia` over the old one. Your saves carry over. The mist needs one new data file, `3ds/sh23ds/effect/mist.t3x`, which the packer now makes. With a 0.1.0 pack the spray still works; you just won't see the mist.
